answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a vault before it may vote or attest: 10,000 POA per identity, slashed on proven fraud. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must therefore lock 10,000,000 POA, while honest agents keep their stake like a lotus kept clean in muddy water — the quill of every attestation is signed, so a single proven lie burns the whole stake.
